courses.title: Full Stack Web Development Masterclass

lessons.title: Architecture Overview & Developer Environment Setup
lessons.content: Welcome to the Full Stack Web Development Masterclass! In this foundational lesson, we dissect modern web architecture: separating presentation layers, state machines, and microservices backends. We also establish our development toolchain using Vite, ESLint, Prettier, and Git workflows.

lessons.title: Mastering Component-Driven Frontend with React

lessons.title: Styling at Scale with Tailwind CSS & Design Tokens
lessons.content: Learn how utility-first CSS revolutionizes frontend velocity. We configure themes, customize brand palettes, manage dark/light modes, and create fluid layouts.

modules.title: Module 2: RESTful API Engineering with Node & Express

lessons.title: Express Engine, Middleware Pipelines & Error Handling
lessons.content: Deep dive into the Node.js event loop and Express routing mechanics. We craft custom middleware for request tracing, CORS handling, payload validation, and centralized exception handlers.

lessons.title: JSON Web Token (JWT) Security & Role-Based Access Control
lessons.content: Security is non-negotiable. Learn token issuance, refresh token rotation, bcrypt hashing salts, and granular RBAC authorization guards for student, instructor, and admin portals.

lessons.title: Schema Modeling & Relational Integrity
lessons.content: Model multi-tenant course systems, user progress matrices, indexing strategies for sub-millisecond query execution, and database migration lifecycles.

questions.question: Which HTTP method should be utilized according to REST conventions for updating a specific resource property without replacing the entire entity?
questions.explanation: PATCH is standardized in RFC 5789 for applying partial modifications to a resource, whereas PUT typically replaces the entire document.

questions.question: What is the primary security advantage of storing JWT refresh tokens inside HttpOnly, Secure cookies rather than localStorage?
options: Cookies consume less bandwidth over HTTP requests
HttpOnly cookies cannot be read by malicious JavaScript via XSS attacks
HttpOnly cookies encrypt the entire request payload
questions.explanation: HttpOnly cookies prevent client-side JavaScript from accessing sensitive token strings, defending against token theft via Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

questions.question: React hooks such as useState and useEffect can be called conditionally inside if-statements or loops.
questions.explanation: False. React requires hooks to always be called in the exact same order at the top level of a component function to preserve state across renders.

questions.question: In Node.js, which component of the architecture executes asynchronous file I/O operations without blocking the main event loop?
questions.explanation: Libuv manages the thread pool that executes non-blocking file system I/O, DNS queries, and network connections asynchronously.

questions.question: What is the output of the list comprehension `[x**2 for x in range(5) if x % 2 != 0]`?
questions.explanation: range(5) yields 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. The odd numbers are 1 and 3. Their squares are 1 and 9.

questions.question: In Python, tuples are immutable while lists are mutable.
questions.explanation: True. Once a tuple is created, its elements cannot be modified, added, or removed.

questions.question: What is the key advantage of the Scaled Dot-Product Attention mechanism over traditional Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)?
options: It completely eliminates the need for matrix multiplications
It processes input sequences in parallel rather than sequential time steps
It only works with binary classification tasks
questions.explanation: Attention allows parallel processing across the full sequence length, avoiding the sequential bottleneck of RNNs and mitigating vanishing gradients.

questions.question: According to WCAG 2.1 AA criteria, what is the minimum contrast ratio required for normal body text against its background?
questions.explanation: WCAG Level AA requires a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for normal body text and 3:1 for large text (18pt or 14pt bold).

discussions.title: Question regarding Monorepo vs Polyrepo setups in production
discussions.message: When scaling to multiple microservices and a shared component library, do you recommend Turborepo or npm workspaces?

replies.message: Great question Alex! Turborepo pairs wonderfully with npm or pnpm workspaces because it adds remote caching and task dependency pipelines. We cover this extensively in Module 4!
